arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent 2D Cartoon sprite, SHARK034. Image1 controls exact original pose, facing, body visibility, pupils and expression. Image2 is STYLE ONLY: gray upper skin, cream/pale underside, crisp black outlines and simple cel shading. One near-vertical complete breaching shark with head pointed LEFT and body descending diagonally down-right toward tail at lower-right. Pale belly is toward viewer, BOTH original dangling pectoral fins visible under the grin, single visible eye. Small attached splash at the bottom. Preserve tall near-upright leaping posture, not horizontal swimming. Match original geometry before style. Attached source water must be white/pale-blue foam and light-blue water only, with transparent gaps and NO dark shadow/puddle. No scenery, floor, horizon, extra animals, glow or text. Preserve whole source silhouette with ample transparent margin. Genuine alpha background. Mouth pink/red, teeth white.
